title: Intromit
summary: INTROMIT', verb transitive [Latin intromitto, supra.] To send in; to let in; to admit. 1. To allow to enter; to be the medium by which a thing enters. Glass in the window intromits light without cold

inlines.v: INTROMIT', verb transitive [Latin intromitto, supra.] To send in; to let in; to admit. 1. To allow to enter; to be the medium by which a thing enters. Glass in the window intromits light without cold into a room. INTROMIT', verb intransitive To intermeddle with the effects of another.
